strategy_definitions.note: Levels use rolling 300-bar stats (no look-ahead). best_combo picks the best band per ticker in-sample (hindsight), not a forward-tested portfolio. Exits: sell at the opposite band, stop at mean - 2 sigma frozen at entry (the live plan support_2); positions still open at the last bar are marked to market and excluded from the win rate.
